info.title: Swiss Law Collection API
info.description:
Static JSON API for 30,000+ unique Swiss federal and cantonal laws, served from GitHub Pages. All endpoints are read-only GET, no authentication, no rate limits.

**Raw law files**: every law is a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/benjamin-arfa/swiss-law/main/{path}` using the `path` values returned by these endpoints (URL-encode the path).

**Counts are deduplicated**: one law counts once regardless of its language versions; `total_files` carries the raw file count.

**Categories are harmonized**: aggregation keys use canonical German labels / dotted tree codes; join `/api/v1/categories/*` to localize (de/fr/it, types also en). One taxonomy (LexFind 'domaine juridique') spans federal and cantonal law.

**Article counts are heuristic**: distinct 'Art. N' / 'Article N' / 'Articolo N' / line-leading '§ N' markers per file; cross-references inflate slightly, metadata-only pages count 0.

Interactive dashboard: https://swiss-law-as-source.github.io/

Stats for one year and entity (CH or canton code)

get.summary: Intercantonal agreements per canton per thematic domain
get.description: Counting unit: canton memberships, not distinct treaties — each agreement counts once per signatory canton whose collection publishes it (a 26-canton concordat counts 26), matching the chstat.ch methodology. The response shape is frozen (additive changes only). For distinct agreements with their signing cantons see /api/v1/stats/concordats_signatories.json.

get.summary: Verification: concordats enacted <= 2003 vs chstat.ch's 2003 table
get.description: Per canton: chstat 2003 domain counts (frozen reference, Institute of Federalism) vs our concordats ENACTED on or before 2003 and still in force. Year = original enactment date (laws are law+version pairs).

200.description: chstat_total, ours totals, per-canton rows with deltas

get.summary: ALL laws (federal + cantonal) on one harmonized taxonomy
get.description: LexFind global systematics tree annotated with {total, federal, cantonal} per node; top_level summary; mapping provenance counts.

get.summary: Law-index master: entities with counts and volumes

200.description: total_laws, link_base, entities{code: {name, laws, total_chars, total_articles, file}}

get.summary: One entity's laws with per-language chars/articles

200.description: items[] with {id, title, link, languages: {lang: {chars, articles, path}}, category fields}

get.summary: Available category dictionaries
Instrument types with labels in de/fr/it
get.description: LexFind category ids are language-stable; stats keys use the German label.

get.summary: Harmonized taxonomy tree (domaine juridique), multilingual
Flat index of the harmonized taxonomy: dotted code → label path (de/fr/it/en)
get.description: One entry per node of the global systematics, keyed on its dotted code, with depth, parent and the ancestors' titles joined into a label path in four languages. Resolves the 'topic' codes used by /api/v1/stats/granular/*.json. English titles are authored in the law repo (LexFind publishes no English tree) and labelled as such in title_en_source.

200.description: note, title_en_source, total, codes{code: {code, depth, parent, title{de,fr,it,en}, path{de,fr,it,en}}}

get.summary: One canton's systematics tree (primary language)
Completeness audit vs LexFind/Fedlex catalogs
get.description: Per canton × instrument type: catalog/present/missing; federal SRs vs Fedlex.

get.summary: Distinct intercantonal agreements with their signing cantons

200.description: total_agreements, agreements[{title, domain, year, n_signatories, signatories[], per_canton{...}}], notes. Signatories are the cantons whose collections publish the text (LexFind has no official member lists).

get.summary: Cantons per concordat, 1848-2003 (reproduction of BADAC graph G1)
get.description: The two units of the 2003 reference, side by side with ours: concordats (agreements with at least two evidenced parties) and canton memberships (one per signing canton per concordat), broken down into the five G1 size bands (2 / 3-4 / 5-10 / 11-19 / 20-26). BADAC shares are shares of the 2564 memberships ('resultats ponderes : 2564 = 100%'), and its per-band concordat counts are implied (memberships / representative band size). Also reports the evidence tier behind every membership we count (published in own collection / named as party in the preamble / named in title) and the number of records for which only one canton could be evidenced.

200.description: title, baseline{}, ours{}, bands[], membership_evidence{}, notes[]

get.summary: Per-enactment-year counts on the harmonized taxonomy (depth <= 2)

200.description: years{YYYY: {code: [federal, cantonal]}}, unknown{code: [federal, cantonal]} for undated laws. Titles: join /api/v1/categories/global.json.

get.summary: Available per-instrument-type canton x domain cross-tabs

200.description: types[{slug, label{de,fr,it,en}, total, path}], ordered by total desc.

get.summary: Cantonal acts of one instrument type per canton per thematic domain
get.description: Same shape as /api/v1/stats/concordats_by_domain.json (domains, cantons, totals, by_year), plus a type{slug, label} object. For the intercantonal type the counting unit is canton memberships.

200.description: domains, cantons{...}, totals, by_year, type{slug, label}, notes

get.summary: Concordats per canton per domain — signatory-canton counting (chstat/BADAC 2003 methodology)
get.description: THE computed concordats statistic: one occurrence per SIGNING canton per agreement (signed by 10 cantons -> 10). Signatories = cantons publishing the text plus cantons named in any language version's title. No scaling, no external baseline; chstat_2003_reference (2,522) is a comparison figure only. Same shape as concordats_by_domain.json plus total_memberships, total_agreements, memberships_until_2003, memberships_added_by_title_evidence.

200.description: domains, cantons{...}, totals, by_year, memberships_until_2003, notes

get.summary: Canton × year × topic cubes at full taxonomy depth — index
get.description: Lists the granular cubes and resolves the data page's instrument-type selector to a file ('' = the signatory-counted concordats table). The cubes carry the SAME counts as the 7-domain tables in /api/v1/stats/, keyed on the full dotted code instead of its first segment, so any (canton, year) slice sums to the same number. They ship separately because the domain tables are fetched on every page load.

200.description: note, topics, by_slug{slug: file}, datasets[{dataset, slug, file, path, counting_unit, codes, total}]

get.summary: One canton × year × topic cube (full taxonomy depth)
get.description: dataset is an instrument-type slug ('gesetz', 'verordnung', …), 'concordats' (published copies) or 'concordats_by_topic_signatories' (memberships). Topics are dotted LexFind global-systematics codes at the depth the source classifies the act; 'uncategorized' = no legal domain in the source. Resolve labels with /api/v1/categories/global_paths.json.

200.description: title, source, dataset, slug, counting_unit, year_semantics, topic_semantics, codes[], by_year{year: {canton: {code: n}}}, totals_by_code, total, notes

get.summary: List of available CSV exports
One instrument type: all cantons x all years x legal domains
Everything: all types x cantons x years x domains (long format)
SDMX-ML 2.1 structural artefacts (agency SLC)

200.description: Codelists CL_CANTON/CL_DOMAIN/CL_INSTRUMENT_TYPE, concept scheme CS_SLC, DSD_LAWS, DSD_CONCORDATS, dataflows DF_LAWS, DF_CONCORDATS

get.summary: Dataflow content as SDMX-CSV 1.0
get.description: Includes per-year marginal totals under the SDMX reserved code _T (canton totals, domain totals, grand total; for DF_LAWS also per-type totals). Totals across all years = sum over TIME_PERIOD.

get.summary: Dataflow content as SDMX-ML 2.1 GenericData
get.description: Includes per-year marginal totals under the SDMX reserved code _T (canton totals, domain totals, grand total; for DF_LAWS also per-type totals). Totals across all years = sum over TIME_PERIOD.

get.summary: Review list of laws excluded from year-based statistics
get.description: Every law with no plausible enactment evidence: 'no_date' (no date fields) or 'implausible_date' (only sentinel/typo values before 1400, e.g. LexFind's 1000-01-01 placeholder). Raw upstream values kept in raw_dates. Browsable at /undated.html.

get.summary: Membership-evidence audit trail for the chstat-2003 reconciliation
get.description: Every accession instrument (Beitritt/adhésion/adesione decree or law referencing an intercantonal agreement the canton does not separately publish) and every Intlex-≤2003 title naming a canton without a published copy, each with a status (counted / published_separately / duplicate_instrument / after_2003 / undated). Only status='counted' rows feed the reconciliation's additional_evidence tiers.

get.summary: Concordat memberships — computed signatory counting

200.description: canton,year,<domains>,total; one occurrence per signing canton per agreement, no scaling

get.summary: Undated laws — fillable correction template

200.description: Fill corrected_enactment_date + correction_note, then `legalize-ch import-dates` applies them to the law files (enactment_date_source: manual_import)
